name: gopher-holes-unlimited
description: A reference serverless application for teaching modern AWS patterns: a mono-Lambda API with an event-handler controller, Lambda Powertools (logging, metrics, tracing, idempotency), and the transactional outbox pattern with DynamoDB and domain events.

scripts.diagram: cfn-dia draw.io -t template.yaml -o diagrams/diagram.drawio -c && drawio diagrams/diagram.drawio -o diagrams/diagram.png
